name: @profullstack/submit-feed
description: One way to add a feed to a directory, shared by every Profullstack site that takes one. Turns whatever a person pastes into a feed: normalises the URL, refuses private addresses, discovers the feed behind a site, parses RSS, Atom and JSON Feed at channel level, reads OPML. Carries the submit contract too: the request shapes a submit endpoint accepts, the reply it gives, the error codes, the MCP tool, and a client that speaks it.
author: Profullstack, LLC
